sampling: experiment.py --audit; seed 719; 80 randomly sampled term occurrences from all short main-session prompts, reviewed as terms, not audio; duplicates intentionally retained

zero_gold_review.scope: First 220 characters only; qualitative omission check, not extractor recall measurement

limitations: Single experimenter, not independent annotators or an ASR confusion study
Pooled exploratory samples informed extractor debugging; ranking hyperparameters alone were selected on development sessions
Some unknown capitalized non-English ordinary words remain false positives
Arbitrary unquoted lowercase product names are missed unless in the fixed technical lexicon
Sampled terms and raw messages are deliberately not persisted
